newsitem.title: USA: MAF Bancorp splits stock, boosts dividend.
newsitem.headline: MAF Bancorp splits stock, boosts dividend.

text.p: MAF Bancorp Inc said Wednesday its directors approved a three-for-two stock split and voted to increase the quarterly cash dividend rate to $0.105 a share from $0.09.
The stock split is payable July 9, record June 17.
The cash dividend will be paid on pre-split basis on July 2, record June 17.
After the stock split, the cash dividend rate would be equal to $0.07 a share.

In other action, MAF Bancorp said its directors adjusted the company's stock repurchase program to reflect the stock split. The plan, which allowed the company to repurchase about 525,000 shares over a one year period ending December 1997, has been adjusted to about 787,000 shares.
